rules.missingSupport: no increase from matched current Product baseline
rules.missingBass: no increase from matched current Product baseline
rules.missingDefiningTone: no increase once independent factor Gold is available

definitions.extraNotesPer100Gold: 100 * extra source-note instances / Gold source-note instances
definitions.reviewPrecision: correct review flags / all review flags; undefined when no flags
definitions.reviewRecall: flagged true errors / all true errors; undefined when no errors
definitions.reviewFalseAlarmPer100Cards: 100 * false review flags / evaluated Gold cards
definitions.cardInflation: (proposed harmonic cards - Gold harmonic cards) / Gold harmonic cards
definitions.runtime10Minute: same published 120 BPM repeated-chord, 10-minute fixture on the same host
definitions.heapUsed: maximum sampled Node heapUsed during the same workload, not total process memory

limitations: Extra note caps are split-specific ceilings rounded just above the measured current Product baseline; matched-product delta must be nonpositive.
Review thresholds are predeclared policy limits because current Product does not emit comparable ReviewReason predictions.
Defining-tone non-regression awaits accepted factor Gold in P9.4.
Resource limits are local-host research gates and require comparable runtime provenance.
